main.description: One compromiso: something that must happen because a cabildeo resolved, written by a steward of the cabildeo's community into their own repo. Title, responsible party and first due date are committed when first indexed; later edits are flagged, not served. Everything that changes afterwards is a com.para.civic.followThroughUpdate.

communityUri.description: Board URI. Must be the board the cabildeo's community resolves to.

optionIndex.description: The option this follows. Served only when it is the cabildeo's winning option.

parent.description: Another followThrough on the same cabildeo that has no parent itself. Only one level of nesting is served.

responsibleDid.description: The account responsible, when it has one.

responsibleLabel.description: An office or body responsible, for example an ayuntamiento.

dueAt.description: First due date. A later one is an update with a note.
